agent_priors_used: General prior (distinct from SPIDER evidence): a program with ~58.8% REVISE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID packets and zero validated external-agent product should convert factory capacity from mechanism/replication proliferation to the small set of prerequisites on the single decisive product test.

General prior: a benchmark whose comparators sit at a 1.0 success ceiling has zero dynamic range and cannot separate a treatment from a baseline at any sample size; the task bank must be engineered so cold/retrieval are legitimately below ceiling.
General prior: prompt underspecification and model capability are separable failure modes; one bounded, goal-specified capability test is a far cheaper discriminator than a full four-arm benchmark.

General prior: when the same claim has been lost three consecutive times to a design/control-plane defect, the next attempt must change the object of study or the instrument contract, not merely re-freeze the same shape.
General prior: a network-behavior result measured on a single egress/geography is vulnerable to vantage-specific artifacts; an independent-vantage replication is the natural strong falsifier.

General prior: a fresh agent's acquisition cost often does not grow with graph depth when site-native discovery channels (sitemaps, on-site search, feeds, structured data) expose deep items directly; this is a prior to test, not SPIDER evidence.

General prior: byte-identical installation of an already-audited artifact plus a pre-freeze positive/negative execution certificate is a low-variance way to discharge an integration blocker before spending on end-to-end benchmarks.

Neither produced a product-grade, audited, byte-pinned parameterized carrier, and the legacy guards (matched counterfactual costs; remove keyword/oracle) are respected here because the certificate is a positive/negative mechanism test, not a cost claim. The R2 precursor EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 established the mechanism is live but unshipped, so this install is the audited promotion step rather than a duplicate; it is also not a pointless rerun because it discharges the single most load-bearing integration blocker and enables the shipped-identity pin the flagship benchmark requires. Alternatives considered and rejected: running the four-arm benchmark now (readiness conditions 2 and 3 unmet), and the first-party C-PRODUCT-ECON recurrence/cost measurement (correct long-term objective but downstream of a live shipped carrier).

allocation.rationale: This is blocker B1 from the cumulative audit and readiness condition (1) for every expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON test: the shipped kernel still lacks distill_parameterized(), defaults the execute threshold to 0.8 while literal candidates sit at 0.5, and no promoted parameterized carrier exists. The prior local handoff (four-arm benchmark, or an asymmetric-discovery fallback) is premature because B2 and B3 are not yet met, so continuing the B1 install is the correct directing of Product onto the product-critical path rather than into an expensive benchmark that cannot have dynamic range. The audit shows the parameterized path is already live and causally attributable on a credential-free substrate (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064, audit PASS: 12/15 unseen identifiers executed) but is NOT shipped; the audit explicitly says 'do not bypass the promotion gate by manual file copy', which is exactly what this pre-freeze positive/negative certificate plus independent audit enforces. C-PARAM-INHERIT is the lane's dominant recent claim (7/10) and remains the right target.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: 436 canonical packets, 0 validated external-agent product. Effective states: C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED (bounded, authorship-separated Chromium fixture); C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL; C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-CROSSSITE, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-WEB-DYNAMICS HYPOTHESIS. The one decisive external-agent test remains blocked by three prerequisites the cumulative audit named: B1 a shipped, promotion-tested parameterized carrier; B2 a non-degenerate task bank whose cold/retrieval comparators are below the success ceiling; B3 a same-model endpoint that can actually complete the minimal multi-step Web-agent task. These are exactly the active PREFREEZE mandates of Product (B1 install + positive/negative certificate), Runtime (B2 asymmetric-discovery task bank) and Intel (B3 prompt-vs-capability capability test). None is discharged, so NONE of the three readiness conditions for expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution holds and no such execution is authorized this cycle. The remaining three lanes each hold a valid, still-unexecuted PREFREEZE mandate that is a materially distinct repair or orthogonal replication rather than a repeated design: Graph's authors-confound-removed goal-to-mechanism selection test, Physics's independent-source-vantage transfer of the bounded S1_STATIONARY denylist result, and Frontier's site-native discovery depth-scaling test whose v1 freeze committed an empty sampling frame (0 seeds, unhreachable falsifier). I therefore CONTINUE all six prefreeze mandates and set the parent-handoff disposition explicitly per lane (USE where the active mandate is the handoff, SUPERSEDE where a previous Global mandate already replaced a stale local next_question). No lane is left accidentally dormant; no lane is redirected onto a lower-value thread merely to change the number.
